title: 语法 · 定语从句｜指代与限定 · 60 句
description: 主宾关系词、限制性与非限制性从句、whose、部分整体、介词前置及关系副词。

items.zh: 能解释这张旧地图的人今天不在。
items.en: The person who can explain this old map is away today.
answers: The person who can explain this old map is away today.
items.notes: who 在从句中作主语，不能省略。

items.zh: 这是唯一能装进壁橱的桌子。
items.en: This is the only desk that fits inside the cupboard.
answers: This is the only desk that fits inside the cupboard.
items.notes: that 指 desk，在从句中作主语。

items.zh: 你推荐给我的播客没有文字稿。
items.en: The podcast you recommended to me has no transcript.
answers: The podcast you recommended to me has no transcript.
The podcast that you recommended to me has no transcript.
items.notes: 关系词在从句中作 recommended 的宾语，可以省略。

items.zh: 我们要找一个能把图纸变成模型的团队。
items.en: We need a team that can turn drawings into models.
answers: We need a team that can turn drawings into models.
items.notes: that 限定是哪类团队；不要再加重复主语 it。

items.zh: 昨晚刮倒的树挡住了北门。
items.en: The tree that fell last night blocks the north gate.
answers: The tree that fell last night blocks the north gate.
items.notes: fell 不及物，that 作主语；区别被动 was felled。

items.zh: 我想感谢那些主动留下来整理会场的人。
items.en: I want to thank the people who stayed to tidy the venue.
answers: I want to thank the people who stayed to tidy the venue.
items.notes: who 作 stayed 的主语，明确感谢对象。

items.zh: 图中你看见的白色区域代表积雪。
items.en: The white areas you see in the image represent snow.
answers: The white areas you see in the image represent snow.
items.notes: you see 为省略宾语关系词的定语从句。

items.zh: 我们拍下了警报触发时出现的那条提示。
items.en: We photographed the message that appeared when the alarm sounded.
answers: We photographed the message that appeared when the alarm sounded.
items.notes: that 作 appeared 主语；when 从句提供发生时间。

items.zh: 我想借的那本册子已经绝版。
items.en: The booklet I wanted to borrow is out of print.
answers: The booklet I wanted to borrow is out of print.
The booklet that I wanted to borrow is out of print.
items.notes: I wanted to borrow 修饰 booklet，主句为 is out of print。

items.zh: 任何接触过原始文件的人都可能知道答案。
items.en: Anyone who has handled the original document may know the answer.
answers: Anyone who has handled the original document may know the answer.
items.notes: anyone 为先行词，who 从句限定人员范围。

items.zh: 露台昨夜刚刷过漆，现在仍有气味。
items.en: The terrace, which was painted last night, still smells of paint.
answers: The terrace, which was painted last night, still smells of paint.
items.notes: 逗号内补充已明确的露台信息，用 which 而非 that。

items.zh: 我的叔叔曾当过锁匠，他认出了这把古锁。
items.en: My uncle, who used to be a locksmith, recognised the old lock.
answers: My uncle, who used to be a locksmith, recognised the old lock.
items.notes: who 从句补充背景，用逗号与主句分开。

items.zh: 我们采用了第二份草图，它留出了更宽的过道。
items.en: We chose the second sketch, which left a wider aisle.
answers: We chose the second sketch, which left a wider aisle.
items.notes: which 回指 sketch，补充选择对象的特征。

items.zh: 所有样本均保持干燥，这一点降低了比较的难度。
items.en: All samples remained dry, which made comparison easier.
answers: All samples remained dry, which made comparison easier.
items.notes: which 回指前句事实，不仅指最近的 dry。

items.zh: 这条消息来得很晚，因此我们的准备时间缩短了。
items.en: The message arrived late, which reduced our preparation time.
answers: The message arrived late, which reduced our preparation time.
items.notes: 逗号后 which 连接前句整体事实及其结果。

items.zh: 丽莎负责舞台调度，她还会在开场前核对道具。
items.en: Lisa, who manages the stage, will also check the props before the opening.
answers: Lisa, who manages the stage, will also check the props before the opening.
items.notes: 人名已明确，who 从句为补充说明。

items.zh: 这个装置靠手摇发电，不需要电池。
items.en: The device, which generates power by hand, needs no battery.
answers: The device, which generates power by hand, needs no battery.
items.notes: which 从句补充工作方式，主句说明无需电池。

items.zh: 我们走到了旧磨坊，那里现在设有游客中心。
items.en: We reached the old mill, where there is now a visitor centre.
answers: We reached the old mill, where there is now a visitor centre.
items.notes: where 在从句中作地点状语，不是主语。

items.zh: 他没有保留收据，这让退款变得复杂。
items.en: He kept no receipt, which complicated the refund.
answers: He kept no receipt, which complicated the refund.
items.notes: which 回指没有保留收据这一事实。

items.zh: 我将在九月抵达，那时果园通常已经开放。
items.en: I will arrive in September, when the orchard is usually open.
answers: I will arrive in September, when the orchard is usually open.
items.notes: when 补充九月的情况，不能把月份写成主语 it。

items.zh: 屋顶漏水的那栋楼已经腾空。
items.en: The building whose roof leaks has been emptied.
answers: The building whose roof leaks has been emptied.
items.notes: whose 可指物，whose roof 等于 the roof of the building。

items.zh: 我认识一位收藏家，他的大部分藏品来自旧市场。
items.en: I know a collector whose objects mostly come from second-hand markets.
answers: I know a collector whose objects mostly come from second-hand markets.
items.notes: whose 修饰 objects，表达所属关系。

items.zh: 我们需要一份来源能够追溯的记录。
items.en: We need a record whose source can be traced.
answers: We need a record whose source can be traced.
items.notes: whose source 为被动从句主语。

items.zh: 这名选手的鞋带断了，因此她中途停下。
items.en: The runner, whose shoelace snapped, stopped midway.
answers: The runner, whose shoelace snapped, stopped midway.
items.notes: 非限制性 whose 从句说明发生在该选手身上的情况。

items.zh: 收到的八份提案中有两份缺少预算。
items.en: We received eight proposals, two of which lacked budgets.
answers: We received eight proposals, two of which lacked budgets.
items.notes: 数量 + of which 回指物的集合。

items.zh: 专家组有六人，其中一人专门研究土壤。
items.en: The panel has six members, one of whom specialises in soil.
answers: The panel has six members, one of whom specialises in soil.
items.notes: one of whom 回指人；不能用 one of who。

items.zh: 仓库里有几台风扇，没有一台能够启动。
items.en: The warehouse contains several fans, none of which will start.
answers: The warehouse contains several fans, none of which will start.
items.notes: none of which 表部分整体的全否定。

items.zh: 她向三位导师征询了意见，他们都建议缩小研究范围。
items.en: She consulted three advisers, all of whom recommended a narrower scope.
answers: She consulted three advisers, all of whom recommended a narrower scope.
items.notes: all of whom 回指三个人；不能用独立主格 all of them 直接逗号连接。

items.zh: 旧信封上有两个地址，其中一个已经无法辨认。
items.en: The old envelope bears two addresses, one of which is illegible.
answers: The old envelope bears two addresses, one of which is illegible.
items.notes: one of which 单数，谓语用 is。

items.zh: 这本手册的索引尤其有用，因此我们保留了它。
items.en: We kept the manual, the index of which was particularly useful.
answers: We kept the manual, the index of which was particularly useful.
items.notes: the index of which 表物的所属，是 whose index 的正式写法。

items.zh: 这是我们从中提取染料的植物。
items.en: This is the plant from which we extract the dye.
answers: This is the plant from which we extract the dye.
items.notes: from which：从该植物中；介词前置时不用 that。

items.zh: 我想知道你所依赖的证据是否可靠。
items.en: I want to know whether the evidence on which you rely is reliable.
answers: I want to know whether the evidence on which you rely is reliable.
items.notes: rely on 决定介词 on；定语从句嵌在 whether 从句中。

items.zh: 我们终于找到了那个曾向他借工具的人。
items.en: We finally found the man from whom we had borrowed the tools.
answers: We finally found the man from whom we had borrowed the tools.
items.notes: borrow from；前置介词后指人用 whom。

items.zh: 这个平台就是向客户发送提醒的渠道。
items.en: This is the platform through which reminders are sent to clients.
answers: This is the platform through which reminders are sent to clients.
items.notes: through which 表通过何种渠道。

items.zh: 请标出你希望安装扶手的那面墙。
items.en: Mark the wall on which you want the handrail fitted.
answers: Mark the wall on which you want the handrail fitted.
items.notes: on which 对应 on the wall，不用 where 替代宾语位置。

items.zh: 调查针对的人群并未参与问卷设计。
items.en: The group for whom the survey was intended did not help design it.
answers: The group for whom the survey was intended did not help design it.
The group for whom the survey was intended didn't help design it.
items.notes: be intended for：为某人设计；for 随搭配前置。

items.zh: 我找不到你提到的那份合同。
items.en: I cannot find the contract that you referred to.
answers: I cannot find the contract that you referred to.
I can't find the contract that you referred to.
items.notes: refer to 的 to 可以留在句尾；that 作介词宾语。

items.zh: 椅子所用的木料来自拆除的建筑。
items.en: The timber from which the chairs were made came from demolished buildings.
answers: The timber from which the chairs were made came from demolished buildings.
items.notes: made from 表原料；from which 连接原料与成品。

items.zh: 这个箱子没有可以把绳子系上去的把手。
items.en: The box has no handle to which a rope can be tied.
answers: The box has no handle to which a rope can be tied.
items.notes: tie ... to ... 决定 to；不能误用 with which。

items.zh: 这是一个每位成员都能参与的过程。
items.en: This is a process in which every member can participate.
answers: This is a process in which every member can participate.
items.notes: participate in 固定搭配决定 in which。

items.zh: 我记得我们第一次看到极光的那个晚上。
items.en: I remember the evening when we first saw the northern lights.
answers: I remember the evening when we first saw the northern lights.
items.notes: when 在从句中作时间状语。

items.zh: 请不要更改我们约定的日期。
items.en: Please do not change the date we agreed on.
answers: Please do not change the date we agreed on.
Please don't change the date we agreed on.
items.notes: date 在从句中是 agreed on 的宾语，不能机械用 when。

items.zh: 这是工匠晾干陶坯的院子。
items.en: This is the yard where the potter dries unfinished pieces.
answers: This is the yard where the potter dries unfinished pieces.
items.notes: where 相当于 in which，在从句中作地点状语。

items.zh: 他们参观的工厂如今已停产。
items.en: The factory they visited is no longer operating.
answers: The factory they visited is no longer operating.
items.notes: factory 作 visited 的宾语，故不使用 where。

items.zh: 我不能接受他迟迟不解释的那个理由。
items.en: I cannot accept the reason that he refuses to explain.
answers: I cannot accept the reason that he refuses to explain.
I can't accept the reason that he refuses to explain.
items.notes: reason 作 explain 的宾语，此处 that 而非 why。

items.zh: 这就是我们需要保留样品的原因。
items.en: This is the reason why we need to retain a sample.
answers: This is the reason why we need to retain a sample.
items.notes: why 修饰先行词 reason，在从句中作原因状语。

items.zh: 有时我们需要承认没有答案。
items.en: There are occasions when we need to admit we have no answer.
answers: There are occasions when we need to admit we have no answer.
There are occasions on which we need to admit we have no answer.
items.notes: occasions 后 when 表在那些场合。

items.zh: 我们已经到了任何微小误差都会影响结果的阶段。
items.en: We have reached a stage where tiny errors affect the result.
answers: We have reached a stage where tiny errors affect the result.
items.notes: stage 表抽象情形，where 作情境状语。

items.zh: 我不喜欢他们处理异议的方式。
items.en: I dislike the way they handle objections.
answers: I dislike the way they handle objections.
items.notes: the way 后从句可不加关系词，不能写 the way how。

items.zh: 那段我们无法联系到任何人的时期最令人不安。
items.en: The period during which we could contact nobody was the most unsettling.
answers: The period during which we could contact nobody was the most unsettling.
items.notes: during which 表整个时期，突出持续范围。

items.zh: 只有需要冷藏的箱子才应放进这间房。
items.en: Only boxes that require refrigeration should enter this room.
answers: Only boxes that require refrigeration should enter this room.
items.notes: 限制性从句决定哪些箱子，不加逗号。

items.zh: 负责送货的三个人都接到了通知。
items.en: The three people responsible for delivery have all been notified.
answers: The three people responsible for delivery have all been notified.
items.notes: 形容词短语可代替 who are responsible，避免不必要从句。

items.zh: 没有标签的瓶子应单独检查。
items.en: Bottles with no labels should be inspected separately.
answers: Bottles with no labels should be inspected separately.
items.notes: with 短语限定范围，相当于 that have no labels。

items.zh: 这就是我认为最能说明问题的例子。
items.en: This is the example that I think illustrates the problem best.
answers: This is the example that I think illustrates the problem best.
items.notes: that 作 illustrates 主语；I think 为插入判断，不再补 it。

items.zh: 我们需要找一位大家都信任其判断的评审。
items.en: We need a reviewer whose judgement everyone trusts.
answers: We need a reviewer whose judgement everyone trusts.
items.notes: whose judgement 作 trusts 宾语，所属与宾语功能并存。

items.zh: 他们只删除了确认为重复的记录。
items.en: They removed only records that were confirmed as duplicates.
answers: They removed only records that were confirmed as duplicates.
items.notes: only 限定删除范围；that 从句进一步限定记录。

items.zh: 我更喜欢解释原因、而不只宣布结果的通知。
items.en: I prefer notices that explain reasons rather than simply announce outcomes.
answers: I prefer notices that explain reasons rather than simply announce outcomes.
items.notes: 同一 that 主语支配 explain 和 announce。

items.zh: 这是委员会推荐、但最终没有采用的方案。
items.en: This is the proposal the committee recommended but never adopted.
answers: This is the proposal the committee recommended but never adopted.
items.notes: 两个并列动词共享省略的宾语关系词。

items.zh: 我们需要那位昨天你说能修复钟表的师傅。
items.en: We need the craftsperson who you said could repair the clock.
answers: We need the craftsperson who you said could repair the clock.
items.notes: who 作 could repair 的主语，不因邻近 said 改为 whom。

items.zh: 她选了最便宜的一条路线，这条路线却并非最短。
items.en: She chose the cheapest route, which was not the shortest.
answers: She chose the cheapest route, which was not the shortest.
She chose the cheapest route, which wasn't the shortest.
items.notes: which 补充同一路线的另一属性，非另选一类路线。
